notes.zh: “账单”：创建债务催收者国家，欠款1481893，约10年后；选项开始债务催收者事件链，1800天后催收者首次到访（4015）。之后每15年（5400天）经隐藏事件4029回访（4030），若与奴隶贩子交战则每5年复查。
notes.en: The Bill: creates the debt-collector country, debt 1481893 (events/origin_events_4.txt:456-512); the first visit follows 1800 days later (4015). Later visits come every 5400 days through hidden 4029 (:997-1041), rechecked every 1800 days while at war with the slavers.

notes.zh: 第二次到访结算后（4017/4020/4025/4032）15天后出现：选择以武力或言辞摆脱债务。
notes.en: Fires 15 days after the second visit is settled (4017/4020/4025/4032): choose to break free by force or by words.

notes.zh: 遗址在开局创建，但需先完成“清理轨道残骸”项目才可见（4931设置旗标）。失败事件使用通用的太空船遗址随机事件，不属于本起源。
notes.en: Created at game start (4000) but visible only after the Kessler debris project finishes (4931). Failure outcomes are the shared site_spaceship_random_events, not origin content (common/archaeological_site_types/07_first_contact_dlc_arc_sites.txt:54-58).

notes.zh: 与“破碎枷锁”起源的互助事件（4110–4141）位于本起源的事件文件中；对方一侧的事件见 origin_broken_shackles。
notes.en: Mutual-support events with the Broken Shackles origin (4110-4141) sit in this origin's event file; the other side is in origin_broken_shackles.
